constituentArticles.title: Mines Ministry notifies Offshore Areas Mineral Rules 2026
constituentArticles.text: Ministry of Mines notified Offshore Areas Mineral Rules 2026 on Feb 3 with penalties up to 5 years jail and ₹1 crore fine for illegal offshore mining.
